fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (46.10414,-123.203936) landed in downtown Clatskanie, ~17 km SE of the actual mill. The Wauna Mill is on the Columbia River near Westport OR, ~92326 Taylorville Rd; mill core relocated to 46.1552,-123.4078.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single ~1 km dedicated access road runs from US-30 through forest to the mill; integrated 1200-acre, 1100-employee mill universally has a controlled security entrance. Gate is internal/deep on the access road, not reachable by Street View panos which only cover US-30.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from facility scale (major integrated GP mill); a manned security booth at a 1100-employee mill is standard, but the booth itself is not positively resolved in overhead imagery — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: Inbound wood-chip and finished-goods truck traffic at a mill of this scale uses a truck scale near the chip yard; small structures observed near the chip-yard access road are consistent with a scale house but not definitively resolved.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Clear diagonal row of ~13-14 parked trailers plus a ~6-7 trailer cluster in an open lot NE of the warehouse (46.1576,-123.409); a second large gravel staging lot near the access-road junction holds additional trailers.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Finished-goods shipping/receiving doors are spread across multiple integrated buildings; ~16 dock positions estimated, low confidence due to process equipment obscuring building faces.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound wood chips delivered to chip yard on the south/east; finished tissue/towel ships from warehouse docks on the north — physically separate operations.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building integrated campus: pulping, paper machines, converting, power/recovery, water treatment, warehouse.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gravel staging lots at the access-road junction and near the chip yard provide ample unused paved/graded width for bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Isolated mill surrounded by forest and the Columbia River; nearest community (Westport) is small. Rural.
